# FDG9124

> AVOID making public members virtual.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.9 Template Method.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Library only: as for FDG6013, the body moves the extensibility for subclasses outside the library into protected virtual members that a public member calls. Not mapped to an analyzer of its own: FDG6013 reports a virtual or abstract method, property, indexer or event declared public in an externally visible class, the case this rule avoids, and a rule maps only its own FDG diagnostic.

## From the book

If a design requires virtual members, follow the template pattern and create a protected virtual member that the public member calls. This practice provides more controlled extensibility.
